correctness.rationale: The cyclic transfer trace exactly enumerates signed induced-degree-one faces for all n>=3. The exact standard-library verifier computes the 16x16 characteristic polynomial and verifies its integer coefficients. Root monotonicity, exact rational brackets, and an all-n comparison prove the signed sum is never zero. Euler--Poincare yields nonzero reduced rational homology and an exponential total-Betti lower bound; brute force independently reproduces n=3..8.

Available prior claims of this research series were checked for equivalence, not reaudited. An unindexed transfer calculation remains possible.

value.rationale: For the natural width-two cyclic graph and the first higher-independence parameter, the theorem settles noncontractibility for every size and gives a uniform exponential rational homology lower bound. The growth constant is forced by a small structural transfer matrix, not an arbitrary parameter. These results provide a meaningful qualitative boundary and quantitative benchmark for eventual full homotopy classification.
